concerns.text: Task T006’s description states it will “skip pairwise comparison and report only 95% bootstrap CIs for performance differences” when any halide group has N < 10. FR‑012 requires that, even when under‑powered, the system must still compute and report pairwise performance‑difference CIs (the CI is the pairwise comparison). By omitting the pairwise difference calculation, T006 weakens the functional requirement, violating constraint preservation.
